requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: predefined character base poses for RPG Maker MV creation, not a narrative illustration. Generate a transparent PNG character model sheet. Image 1 is ORIGINAL Arena race appearance evidence: use ONLY the people, ignore background/map/text/UI. Image 2 is APPROVED project's dark fantasy material/paint finish continuity (dungeon), not character anatomy. Image 3 is existing Breton pilot visual finish/scale reference; do not copy her identity onto other races. Original Arena identity takes priority over generic modern fantasy or later Elder Scrolls appearances. DESCRIPTION: Arena 1994 Argonians: upright humanlike proportions, BLUE-GRAY reptilian face/skin, short humanoid snout, green frill/crest; do not replace with modern Skyrim long dragon snout or digitigrade legs. Male dark brown open collar long-sleeve shirt, black trousers, brown boots. Female ivory blouse, black trousers, sturdy dark boots, copper red hair/frill as reference. No tail unless clearly present in source; use no visible tail here. Painterly figurative dark fantasy, clearly drawn silhouettes, aged matte cloth/leather, muted natural color, cool soft shadows, no pixel art/chibi/anime/plastic3D. SCENE: absolutely transparent background, no ground, fog, shadows cast on ground, text, numbers, watermarks, labels, frame, borders or weapons. LAYOUT: 3 columns by 4 rows, exact equal cells, no grid lines. Row 1: MALE exploration front facing down-screen; MALE exploration back facing up-screen; MALE exploration left-facing profile. Row 2: MALE exploration right-facing profile; MALE combat side view facing LEFT; MALE portrait bust in three quarters. Row 3: FEMALE exploration front facing down-screen; FEMALE exploration back facing up-screen; FEMALE exploration left-facing profile. Row 4: FEMALE exploration right-facing profile; FEMALE combat side view facing LEFT; FEMALE portrait bust in three quarters. Every cell contains ONE figure only, centered, fully inside with generous 40px transparent margins on all sides. Exploration poses: fixed orthographic upper-oblique 2D RPG map camera looking downward 30 degrees; no isometric perspective. Front/back/left/right must show consistent head/hair/clothes. Combat pose: full body SIDE profile, left-facing guarded unarmed stance, slight bent knees, same identity, same clothes and boots, no equipment. Portrait: only head/shoulders, same face/hair/clothes. Full bodies occupy comparable height, feet aligned per row. Exactly same character within each gender across all six cells; differences across genders do not imply mechanical bonuses. Static pose study, not fake animation. Strong readability for final48x64 map,96x96 combat,144x144 portrait. Favor clear large forms over surface noise. All limbs, hair, ears and footwear fully contained. Do not use source pixelization. Do not add capes, new armor, jewelry, props or scenery. Intended source size1536x2048.
